eps.t: The New Droid Friends / Batuu Bonanza
eps.o: The Jedi recover a stolen part from a troublemaking droidsmith; Kai loses a package on Batuu.

eps.t: Music Mayhem / The Night Lights of Tenoo
eps.o: The Jedi save a concert from a troublemaking Rek; a camping trip to see nightlights goes awry.

eps.t: Journey to the Bottom of Naboo / Speeder Surprise
eps.o: The Jedi go underwater to recover a lost artifact. Kai helps a cub get back to his family.

eps.t: Scrapping for a Song / Bell and the Band
eps.o: The Jedi help Nash find her mom a birthday gift; Bell and Kai use music to save pets.

eps.t: To Do Good / Nubs and the Bumbling Bandits
eps.o: Captured by Rek, Taborr asks the Jedi for help; Nubs chases bandits who stole from their ship.
Rek builds a new droid to stop the Jedi. Raxlo's old harvester falls into the hands of a foe.
When their festival is threatened, the Jedi team up with Rek to stop Apexx and his droid army.
